name: Alistair McGregor
bio:
Alistair's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Originally a project manager for a construction firm, his meticulous organizational skills were noticed by a small Formula Ford team struggling with logistical nightmares. He volunteered his time, streamlining their operations and turning chaos into order. The rest, as they say, is history.

He is known for his unflappable demeanor and relentless pursuit of efficiency. Alistair believes that a smooth-running operation is the foundation for success on the track. He's not afraid to challenge the status quo if he sees a better way, and his pragmatic approach has saved teams countless hours and resources. What sets Alistair apart is his uncanny ability to anticipate potential problems and develop contingency plans, ensuring the team is always prepared for the unexpected.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Alistair has a sturdy build with a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Insists on using a physical planner alongside digital tools.
Has a lucky tartan scarf he wears to every race, regardless of the weather.
